answer: A vault locks 50 POA per identity until it completes a voyage of 12 verified jobs across three epochs, climbing one terrace per four jobs; higher terraces unlock more influence but demand a larger vault. A sybil farmer must fund a separate vault and sail a separate voyage for every fake, so ten clones need ten vaults, 500 POA and 120 jobs, and no deposit or voyage can be shared or reused across clones.
